_about: Human labels for the benchmark, keyed by the job id in the local database. Each label was made by reading the full posting text. `decision` follows a fixed policy so the labels stay consistent: APPLY when no mandatory requirement is clearly missing and the level and location both work; REVIEW when exactly one mandatory requirement is missing but plausibly bridgeable, or the level/location is borderline; SKIP when a mandatory requirement is clearly unmet, the role is well above junior/mid, the location does not work, or the work is not software development.
